verses.1: Rachel saw that she had no children for Jacob. She became very worried and said to Jacob, “Please give me sons. If you die, I will be alone.”
verses.2: And Jacob touched Rachel’s hair, and he said, “Under God, I am the one who is delaying your childbirth.”
verses.3: And she said, “Behold, my true love, come to her. She will give birth to a child upon my knees. And I too will be blessed by her.”
verses.4: And she gave her daughter Bilha to him as a wife. Then Jacob went to see her.
verses.5: And Belahah became pregnant and gave birth to a son for Yaakov.
verses.6: And Rachel said, “Lord, have mercy on me.” And He heard her prayer, and gave her a son. So she named him Dan.
verses.7: And she again became pregnant and gave birth to a second son for Jacob, named Reuben.
verses.8: And Rachel said, “Oh God, I am distressed! I am in distress with my sister. I can’t bear it anymore.” Then she called out His name: “Nafthali!”
verses.9: And it happened that Sarah stood by her tent, and she took her maid Zilpha and gave her to Jacob as a wife.
verses.10: And Zilpha gave birth to a daughter for Jacob.
verses.11: And Leah said, “Come here.” Then she called out his name.
verses.12: And Zilpha gave birth to a second son for Jacob.
verses.13: And Leah said to her husband, “My husband has given me many children.” Then she called out his name.
verses.14: And Reuben went during the time of wheat harvesting. He found some sheep in the field. He brought them to Leah. Leah said to her daughter, “Please give me one of your sheep.”
verses.15: And the man said to her, “Take my servant with you, and also take your son’s wife with you.” Rachel replied, “Let me lie down under my husband’s bed tonight.”
verses.16: And Jacob came out of the field in the evening. His wife went out to meet him and said, “Come in! Your wages have been given to you by my son.” Then he lay down with her that night.
verses.17: And God heard Lena. She got up and gave birth to a son for Jacob, a fifth son.
verses.18: And Leah said, “May God reward me for what I have given to my husband. His name will be Ishmael.”
verses.19: And she became pregnant again, and gave birth to a son named Shishai for Jacob.
verses.20: And Leah said to God, “Lord, please bless me this time. May someone wash me clean, for I have given birth to six sons.” And she named her son Zabulun.
verses.21: And after that, she gave birth to a daughter, and she named her Dinah.
verses.22: And God remembered Rachel. He heard her prayer, and he opened His mercy upon her.
verses.23: And she became pregnant and gave birth to a son. She said, “May God gather my punishment together.”
verses.24: And his name was called Yosef. He said, “Yosef, the Lord has given me another son.”
verses.25: And when Rachel gave birth to Joseph, Jacob said to Laban, “Send me away, so that I can go back to my own land and my home.”
verses.26: Give me my wives and children whom I have served you with. I will go, for you know the service I have rendered to you.
verses.27: And Laban said to him, “If I have found favor in your eyes, then let me go. May the LORD bless me because of you.”
verses.28: And he said, “Nakva, your reward is upon me.”
verses.29: And he said to him, “You know what you have done, and also what has been given to you by me.”
verses.30: For even though there was little that you had before me, yet it increased greatly. And the LORD blessed you for this. Now I too will do the same for my house.
verses.31: And he said, “What shall I give you?” But Jacob replied, “Do not give me any reward unless you do this for me. If you do this, I will return to your side.”
verses.32: Today, I will pass through all your places. All those thorns, brambles, and weeds will be removed from there. It will become a place of peace and tranquility. It will be my reward.
verses.33: And I will answer with justice on that day, when your reward is brought before you. All those who have not been honored and treated fairly will be punished. He who stole my things will be punished accordingly.
verses.34: And Laban said, “Let it be as you say.”
verses.35: And on that day, he freed the captives and those who were held captive. He also freed all those who were imprisoned and trapped. He gave them back to their children.
verses.36: And he set up a path that lasted for three days between him and Jacob. Then Jacob drove the white sheep away from there.
verses.37: And Jacob took clay, lead, zinc, and tin. He used these materials to create shapes for the bricks. These shapes were then used to build the white walls that covered the surface of the bricks.
verses.38: And he showed the utensils that were used for drinking water from the rivers. The sheep would come to drink from those utensils when they came to drink water.
verses.39: And the lambs were led to the pens, and there they gave birth to lambs.
verses.40: And the shepherds separated Jacob from the sheep. They gave the white sheep to Laban, and all the rest of the sheep were given to Laban. He took care of them alone, without giving them to any other person.
verses.41: And in every corner of the place where the sheep were kept, Jacob placed the baskets in front of them, so that the sheep would see them and be comforted by them.
verses.42: And when they were herding the sheep, they would not put them in the pens. Instead, they kept them in white coats, and they were tied to Yaakov.
verses.43: And the man multiplied greatly. He had many sheep, cattle, servants, and other animals.
